notes: Landing Cost File is now a working sheet: every box can be typed in (item, category, size, MRP, rate, TCS, SP fee, round off, landing cost) and the file formula fills itself in — TCS follows each line percentage and Landing = Rate + TCS + SP fee + Round off. New items can be added straight on the page with the figures worked out for you. Each line now carries a CATEGORY taken from your Beverage Control sheet, with a category filter and a No-category tab. The three comparison columns are gone and the sheet is compact. It is still a price list only: no rate anywhere else changes.
